Chores Teach Responsibility and Love
👆 Tap any highlighted word to learn it

Debra, a loving and patient mother, decided it was time for a life lesson for her 10-year-old son, Tommy. She handed him a list of chores for him to do. He stared at it with wide eyes. "Mom, do I have to do all of these?" Tommy said. Debra smiled and said, "Yes, sweetheart. I believe in you. You can do it, and I'll help you every step of the way.

Tommy reluctantly accepted the list and set off on his mission. First, he watered the thirsty garden. Then, he tackled the stack of dishes, singing a song while scrubbing. As he folded laundry, he found his favorite superhero shirt. Debra joined him to make the bed, the sheets floating in the air, like a fun game. Cleaning his room was the most challenging. He had to rearrange his toys and collect all his scattered art supplies.

Finally, Tommy handed his mom the completed list, beaming with pride. Debra said, "You did an amazing job, Tommy." Tommy hugged his mom tightly, realizing that his mom was teaching him about responsibility and love.
